composition.motif: Ben Mua leitmotif: D major pentatonic question phrase hanging on scale degree 2; the full flute tail stays reserved for the resolve stinger and rift_finale
composition.structure: Additive intensity layer over ben_mua (17 bars @ 72 bpm): soft drum on the bar line, bass fill on beats 1 and 3 on the bar's own root, shaker on the offbeats (rain patter), low pluck echo of the motif head on bars 8 and 15 (bars where the base has no melody), and an E5 bell toll on bars 5 and 11 (E is the cue's hanging note). The base has no drums, no shaker, a bass line on beats 0 and 2 only, and a single D5 bell on the final bar; this layer adds the pulse the pier theme withholds. No flute, no drops, no pad. -25 LUFS target; combined base+layer loudness measured from real bytes.

notes: Phase layers are ADDITIVE loops at the parent cue's tempo/bars (-25 LUFS target): they play over the base cue, they do not replace it. Combined base+layer loudness/true-peak is measured from real bytes and recorded per layer.

Each MD6 layer adds only what its base and the earlier layers do not already do: ben_mua intensity adds the pulse the pier theme withholds (bar-line drum, bass fill, offbeat shaker, motif echo on melody-free bars, E5 bell on the hanging note); lam_trieu intensity completes the leaf-tick shaker grid the base leaves half-empty and adds the tonic G5 bell the base never tolls; sa_hoa intensity completes the two-beat drum pulse and the offbeat shaker grid and adds the tonic A5 bell the base never tolls.

Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the MD6 files are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/layers/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files, their cue bindings, or the checkpoint-26/30/MD1/MD2/MD3/MD4/MD5 cues.

No ear audition has been done; loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes. Loop seams are recorded per looping cue in the delivery manifest: wrapJump after a disclosed 0.25 s end-landing loop construction, wrapJumpRaw before it.
